# Loading the Datasets

```{python}

# Climate data

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
climate_df = pd.read_csv("data/POWER_climate_data_Puerto_Rico_1986_2024.csv")
disease_df = pd.read_csv("data/weekly_data_dengue_epidemic_alert_thresholds_1986_June2024.csv")


climate_df.head()
disease_df.head()


```

# Converting Climate Data to Weekly Format

```{python}

climate_df["date"] = (
    pd.to_datetime(climate_df["YEAR"].astype(str) + "-01-01")
    + pd.to_timedelta(climate_df["DOY"] - 1, unit="D")
)
# Replace missing values
cols = ["T2M", "T2M_MAX", "T2M_MIN", "PRECTOTCORR", "RH2M"]
climate_df[cols] = climate_df[cols].replace(-999, float("nan"))

# Aggregate by week
climate_weekly = (
    climate_df
    .set_index("date")
    .resample("7D", origin="1986-01-01", label="left", closed="left")
    .agg({
        "T2M": "mean",
        "T2M_MAX": "max",
        "T2M_MIN": "min",
        "PRECTOTCORR": "sum",
        "RH2M": "mean"
    })
    .rename(columns={
        "T2M": "temp_avg",
        "T2M_MAX": "temp_max",
        "T2M_MIN": "temp_min",
        "PRECTOTCORR": "precip_total",
        "RH2M": "humidity_avg"
    })
    .reset_index()
    .rename(columns={"date": "weekdate"})
)

climate_weekly.head()

```


# Merge with Disease Data

```{python}
disease_df["weekdate"] = pd.to_datetime(disease_df["weekdate"])

all_data = disease_df.merge(
    climate_weekly,
    on="weekdate",
    how="left"
)

all_data.columns
```
